swaps.review: Abaddon's cascade X is the life opponents lost this turn. Stormfist's upkeep trigger makes each opponent lose 1 before your first main phase, so from that turn on every hand spell up to MV 3 cascades without needing another damage source; it also draws for you every upkeep. Remora draws only off opponents' noncreature spells and never turns on Abaddon. Abaddon decks play Stormfist 48.0% vs Remora 12.6%; rank 2,011 is within the guard.

swaps.review: Every Kefka enter/attack trigger makes each opponent discard, so Caress drains 2 from each opponent per trigger. With the list's Wheel of Fortune, Windfall-style wheels and Gamble-style discards it threatens a lethal drain without combat. After Kefka transforms, his back face draws a card for each point of life an opponent loses during your turn. Final Fortune is a one-turn gamble that loses the game if the combo fails. 33.4% of Kefka decks play Caress against 11.1% for Final Fortune (overall ranks 2,404 vs 1,531, within the guard). It also removes an extra-turn card.

swaps.review: Kefka forces opponents to discard every enter and attack, and Brain Freeze mills them. With Dauthi those cards are exiled with void counters instead, and Dauthi can be sacrificed to play the best one for free. It also turns off opposing graveyard engines. Valley Floodcaller is a second flash enabler that Borne Upon a Wind already covers. Kefka decks play Dauthi 33.1% vs Floodcaller 16.1%; overall rank 395 vs 761. The proposal was Brain Freeze, but that card is a piece of the list's Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond / Lotus Petal combos and stays.
